info.title: dotnet-superclean
info.description: Removes all bin and obj folders from a .NET solution or project directory.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Removes all bin and obj folders from a .NET solution or project tree.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: List folders that would be deleted without actually deleting them.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show each folder as it is deleted.

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The root directory to clean. Defaults to the current directory. [default: <path>]
